connect.title: Xhuma le foni
connect.sub: Faka lolu khodi ku-pr.social kumkhakha wamathuluzi. Ifoni izoxhuma ngokuzenzakalela.
connect.path: Ku-pr.social: Amathuluzi → I-app yokuphequlula → faka ikhodi.
connect.expired.sub: Ikhodi isebenza amaminithi alishumi. Thola entsha.
connect.fail.network: Akukho ukuxhumana ne-pr.social. I-app izozama futhi ngokuzenzakalela uma ukuxhumana kwe-inthanethi kubuyile.
connect.fail.often: Kucelwe amakhodi amaningi kakhulu kule nethiwekhi. Zama futhi ngemva kwemizuzu engu-{min}.
connect.fail.busy: I-pr.social imatasa manje. Zama futhi ngemva kwemizuzu eyodwa.
connect.done.title: Ixhunyiwe
connect.off.sub: Ikhishwe ku-akhawunti yakho ku-pr.social. Ukuze uyixhume futhi, sebenzisa ikhodi entsha engaphansi.
connect.no.tasks: Ukuze uxhume ifoni kudingeka okungenani imisebenzi evunyiwe engu-{need}. Yenza imisebenzi ku-pr.social, bese ufaka le khodi futhi.
connect.no.devices: I-akhawunti yakho isivele ixhumeke namadivayisi ayi-{max}. Nqamula elinye ku-pr.social kumkhakha wamathuluzi, bese ufaka le khodi futhi.
connect.no.device: Le foni ayikwazi ukuxhunywa. Faka i-app kuphela ku-pr.social: ama-emulator namafoni ane-root awasekelwa.
connect.no.restricted: I-akhawunti yakho ikhawulelwe. Ifoni ingaxhunywa lapho ukukhawulela kususiwe.
stats.title: Izibalo
limits.title: Imikhawulo
limits.hour.hint: Inani lamasayithi lale foni angawabonisa ngehora
limits.day.hint: Inani lamasayithi lonke i-akhawunti yakho angawabonisa ngosuku, kuzo zonke izinsiza ndawonye
home.week.bars: Ukuholwa yile foni ezinsukwini ezingu-7 ezedlule
home.ready: Amasayithi avulwa ngokuzenzakalela, esinye ngemva kwesinye, kuyilapho i-app isevulekile esikrinini. Isikrini asicimi, siyafifala.
home.need.wifi: Xhuma ku-Wi-Fi noma uvumele idatha yeselula
home.need.internet: Alukho uxhumo lwe-inthanethi: xhuma ku-Wi-Fi noma idatha yeselula
home.need.charger: Xhuma ichaja noma uvumele ukubonisa ngebhethri
home.need.cool: Ifoni ishisa kakhulu: amasayithi azoqala lapho ipholile
home.update.hint: Izofakwa phezu kwalena ngemizuzu engaba yimizuzu. I-akhawunti nokuholwa kwakho kuzogcinwa.
home.update.allow: I-Android idinga imvume yakho ukuze ifake izinhlelo ezivela ku-PR Surf. Vumela bese ubuyela: umfakeli uzovula ngokuzenzakalela.
home.update.failed.network: Ukulayisha kuphazamisekile. Hlola uxhumo lwakho lwe-inthanethi bese uzama futhi.
home.update.failed.space: Akukho sikhala esanele kwimemori yefoni. Khulula isikhala bese uzama futhi.
home.update.failed.site: Ukubuyekezwa akukwazanga ukulayishwa. Zama futhi ngemva kwemizuzu embalwa.
gate.blocked.sub: I-PR.SOCIAL ivimbele le foni. Bhalela usizo: lapho kuzochazwa imbangela futhi kuzotshelwa ukuthi kufanele wenzeni.
gate.restricted.sub: Ngenkathi ukukhawulela kusasebenza, ukuphequlula akutholakali. Usizo lungakuchazela imbangela.
gate.update.sub: Le nguqulo ayisasebenzi. Eyintsha izofakwa ngemizuzu engaba yimizuzu, futhi i-akhawunti nokuholwa kwakho kuzogcinwa.
gate.closed.sub: I-app ihlola yodwa, ngakho akukho okudingeka uyenze. Uma ukuphequlula sekutholakala futhi, inkinobho yokuqala izobuya.
fix.vpn.sub: Amanye ama-oda abala abavakashi kuphela uma kungasetshenziswa i-VPN. Vala i-VPN ukuze uthole amasayithi amaningi.
wait.empty.sub: Amasayithi amasha avela lapho abakhangisi beoda izivakashi. Ukuhlolwa okulandelayo ngo-{time}. Ungavali i-app.
wait.busy.sub: Ukubonisa kuzoqhubeka ngo-{time}. Amasayithi asevele abonisiwe ngeke alahleke.
wait.network.sub: Umzamo olandelayo ngo-{time}. Amasayithi asevele abonisiwe ngeke alahleke.
pause.no_wifi.sub: Amasayithi abonakala kuphela nge-Wi-Fi. Xhuma ku-Wi-Fi noma uvumele idatha yeselula.
pause.no_charger.sub: Amasayithi abonakala kuphela ngenkathi ifoni ishaja.
pause.low_battery.sub: Xhuma ichaja, bese ukubonisa kuqhubeka ngokuzenzakalela.
pause.check_missed.sub: Umbuzo “Ukhona yini?” awuphendulwanga ngesikhathi. Cindezela “Qhubeka” ukuze uqhubeke nokukhombisa.
check.title: Ukhona yini?
check.sub: Thepha inkinobho engezansi ukuze uqhubeke. Ukukhombisa kumisiwe uze uphendule.
journal.title: Umlando
journal.empty.title: Akukho lutho okwamanje
journal.empty: Amawebhusayithi uhlelo oluwakhombisayo azovela lapha, futhi ngalowo nalowo kuzobhalwa ukuthi ubalwe yini.
why.LOAD: Iwebhusayithi ayivulekanga. Le nkinga isuka kuwebhusayithi, hhayi kuwe.
why.DNS: Ikheli lewebhusayithi alisasebenzi. Akudingeki wenze lutho.
why.TIMEOUT: Iwebhusayithi lilayishe isikhathi eside kakhulu. Kungenzeka ukuthi lihamba kancane, noma uxhumo lubuthakathaka: i-Wi-Fi ivamise ukusiza.
why.HTTP: Iwebhusayithi iphendule ngephutha. Akudingeki wenze lutho.
why.SSL: Isitifiketi sokuphepha sewebhusayithi asivumelekile, ngakho uhlelo aluyivulanga.
why.BLOCKED: Ukuvikelwa kwewebhusayithi akuvumelanga uhlelo ukuthi livule ikhasi.
why.VIDEO: Ividiyo ayiqalanga: mhlawumbe isusiwe noma yenziwa yimfihlo.
why.CRASH: Isiphequluli sohlelo sehlulekile kulelikhasi futhi sesiqalile kabusha.
why.EARLY: Uhlelo lubike leli webhusayithi lingakafiki isikhathi sokuboniswa kwalo sivumela. Qinisekisa ukuthi usuku nesikhathi esifonini sisethelwe ukuzishintsha ngokuzenzakalela.
why.SHORT: Ikhasi alizange lihlale esikrinini isikhathi esanele. Gcina uhlelo luvulekile nesikrini sivuliwe.
why.VIDEO_SHORT: Ividiyo ayidlalanga isikhathi esanele: isikhathi sathathwa yisikhangiso noma ukumisa.
why.CONTROL: Lalikhasi kwakuyikhasi lokuhlola le-pr.social, futhi lakhonjiswa ngendlela engalungile.
why.NOT_SHOWN: Ukukhombisa kumile kungakafiki isikhathi salo webhusayithi.
why.RESTRICTED: I-akhawunti yakho ikhawulelwe: amawebhusayithi awabalwa uze ukhawulelo lususwe.
why.GONE: Uhlelo lubike leli webhusayithi sekwephuze kakhulu: bekuvaliwe isikhathi eside.
settings.title: Izilungiselelo
settings.wifi.hint: Amawebhusayithi namavidiyo ngeke asebenzise idatha yeselula
settings.charging.hint: Isikrini asicimi, futhi ngesikhathi sokushaja ibhethri alikhiphi amandla
settings.dim.hint: Ngemva komzuzu wokuthinta kokugcina, isikrini siyafiphala futhi ukukhombisa kuyaqhubeka
settings.support.hint: Imibuzo mayelana nohlelo noma ngemali oyithola
settings.disconnect.ask: Le foni ngeke isaxhunyaniswa ne-@{user} futhi. Ungayixhuma futhi ngekhodi elisha.
toast.mobile: Idatha yeselula ivumelekile. Lokhu ungakushintsha ezilungiselelweni.
toast.nocharger: Ukukhombisa sekuvunyelwe nangaphandle kokushaja. Lokhu ungakushintsha ezilungiselelweni.
toast.noupdate: Inguqulo entsha ayikalungi. Zama futhi kamuva.
settings.mini.hint: Uma uphuma ku-app, izayithi ziyaqhubeka zibonakale kwiwindi elincane phezu kwezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza.
settings.mini.denied: Ukuboniswa kwesithombe esisesithombeni kukhubazekile ku-PR Surf ezilungiselelweni zefoni
home.mini: Ungasebenzisa ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza ngalesi sikhathi: izayithi ziyaqhubeka emawindini amancane.
show.resumed: Ukubonisa kuqhubeke kusukela lapho kwamiswa khona
notify.stopped.sub: Thepha ukuze uqhubeke: izayithi ziyoqhubeka kusukela lapho zamiswa khona.
skip.title: (ask as a question; keep it short)
skip.sub: Ngeke ibalwe, futhi ngeke iphinde iboniswe kuwe.
